unsupported.brand-studio: Runs on Netlify/Supabase functions with its own contracts (brand, campaign, assets); not exposed yet.
unsupported.video-pages: Own app with a client-side renderer (Remotion); out of scope for v1.
unsupported.zackd: Own app (src/apps/zackd) with its own backend; not exposed yet (the SmartVid repo has Zack D tools).
unsupported.motion-director: Own app with a client-side renderer (Remotion); out of scope for v1.
unsupported.design-agent: Own agent app (src/apps/design-agent); not reviewed yet.
unsupported.thumbnail-studio: Uses its own OpenAI prompt-enhance and Supabase pipeline (/api/proxy/thumbnail-generate); not exposed yet. Image tools cover plain thumbnails.
unsupported.muapi-studio: Embeds the vendored muapi.ai studio in the browser with the user's own MuAPI key; the same models are reachable through the generation tools and search_models.
unsupported.smartwarmupai: Embedded dashboard and Help site running on recorded demo data; it has no generation to expose.
unsupported.media-hub: Own app (VidBee media hub) with its own host; not exposed yet.
